requirements: R1: Address systemic sync failure between internal status and GitHub PR reality
R2: Remove fraudulent stubs masking the status mismatch

slices.title: Patch status sync logic and remove fraudulent stubs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the direct patch for this epic, I want to remove the fraudulent stubs and fix the sync logic, so that internal task statuses accurately reflect actual GitHub PR states
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task linked to a GitHub PR that is closed without a merge
When the sync execution process verifies the status
Then fraudulent stubs are removed and the internal status is accurately updated to unmerged
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce status mismatch occurrences and false positive completion reports from >100 to 0
